==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I create a superhero leaderboard app. The app allows for users to log their heroic deeds. An AI then ranks each user on a public leaderboard, relative to which users it believes to be the most heroic.

The leaderboard encourages competition. More and more people start trying to reach the top of the leaderboard. This leads to a sudden influx in superheroes around the world.

I become a target for supervillains. They're upset, because I helped to inspire a new age of heroes. I hire a superhero with rubber based powers to act as my body guard.
